title: Study 3 — Confirmatory replication with a COLREGs-aware rule-based baseline
description: A confirmatory robustness study on VesselEnvV3 that (a) adds a non-learning COLREGs-aware rule-based controller as a classical baseline against the four value-based DQN variants, and (b) raises the seed count to 15 to give the paired post-hoc the statistical power that was floor-limited (n=6) in Study 2. Focused 3-condition grid (clean, mid, harsh) keeps the 15-seed design computationally feasible. All metrics are genuinely computed by the environment; nothing is fabricated. The deployed web app is unaffected.
motivation: Study 2 found large degradation effect sizes but its per-algorithm paired Wilcoxon tests were floor-limited at n=6 (min Holm-adjusted p ~ 0.125). Study 3 uses 15 seeds so paired tests can cross significance.

A rule-based COLREGs-aware controller provides a meaningful non-RL reference point: is a classical charted-channel-following controller more robust to sensing/comms degradation than learned value-based policies?

RuleBased.policy: charted-channel following (Dijkstra plan) + COLREGs-style collision avoidance + channel/IALA keeping; uses the SENSED goal bearing from the observation so it is subject to the same sensor noise / comms loss as the RL agents; no training

seed_policy: SAME 15 seeds for every (agent, condition) cell (shared/paired). env_seed = 42 + seed. RL agent-side RNG = mulberry32(seed*1000003 + 12345). RuleBased is deterministic given env_seed (its only randomness is any tie-breaking, which is fixed).

training.note: RL agents train 130 episodes as in Study 2; RuleBased does not train (evaluated directly).

evaluation.policy: greedy (RL) / deterministic (RuleBased); held-out missions from the seeded stream

cells_breakdown: 5 agents x 3 conditions x 15 seeds = 225 (45 RuleBased instant + 180 RL ~15s each)

analysis_plan.omnibus: two-way factorial: agent (5) x condition (3), y ~ agent*condition + seed, partial eta^2
analysis_plan.primary_contrast: RuleBased vs each DQN variant, per condition — paired Wilcoxon (n=15 now has power) + Holm + BH, Cohen's d_z + Cliff's delta
analysis_plan.robustness: clean vs harsh per agent (paired), with 15 seeds

scope_notes: Confirmatory + baseline extension; separate from Study 1 (VesselEnvV2) and Study 2 (VesselEnvV3, 6 seeds).
VesselEnvV3 is a synthesized physical/sensing/comms testbed, not a validated hydrodynamic/RF simulator.
Deployed web application (environment.js) is unaffected; all Study 3 code is offline research.
